purpose: Commits the additive schema repair of the RUN-SEMBIN-1b9afe manifest: the superseding manifest_v2.yaml, the correction record that reports the defect and the reasoning behind repairing rather than suppressing it, and the additive_schema_completion entry that routes the schema check to the new record. SNAPSHOT, not a ledger archive, on the precedent of TASK-20260913-b03e25: the correction performs no research-state transition, so no ledger archive is due.
why_this_must_be_committed: tools/run_supersession_registry.yaml binds both records BY HASH. An uncommitted superseding record is a registry entry pointing at a working tree, which is the same failure the registry exists to prevent.
commit_sha_note: A receipt cannot contain the hash of the commit that contains it. The commit binding lives in this task's `archive` block in dispatch_queue.json, which is deliberately not one of the declared artifacts, so recording it there is a later commit that does not disturb this one.

superseded_record_still_pinned.note: Unchanged and committed in 40e1cf727. It remains the governing text for every field it carries; check_run_supersessions() keeps requiring that it exist and hash to this value.

verification_note: Hashes are sha256 of file content, verified against HEAD under content_first binding. Recomputed at archive time immediately before the commit this receipt is part of.
what_is_not_claimed: Asserts only that these bytes were committed. It asserts NOTHING about the measurement in RUN-SEMBIN-1b9afe, nothing about whether its ratio-above-1 diagnosis holds, and nothing about H-SEMBIN-c5b2e0. The schema repair makes the package readable by the validator; it does not make any of its numbers right. TASK-20260913-31d530 remains the run's independent scientific review and has not run.
